main_body: Tall wooden medicine cabinet with a 3x4 grid of drawer fronts, standing on dark red feet
top_band: Light orange L~176 rows 2-3, with L~153 row 4 (a step of only about 23 L). A dark red edge row follows at row 5. The band is about 2-3 rows tall.
evidence: The column at x=16 shows a 2-3 row light cap (rows 2-4), then a dark red row 5, then the face from row 6 to row 26: drawer rows with a light edge at rows 7, 12, 17 and 22, and wood tones below. The face is about 21 rows, so the top is only about 3 rows of a roughly 27-row body. That is the thin cap of the guide's red 'front elevation: top 1' and 'rim only: top 2' cases, not the 5-row top of the green cabinet. The step from L176 to L153 is under 25, and no separate lighter front-edge line marks where the top meets the face. The drawers are painted face-on as vertical faces, and the top is too thin to read as a horizontal surface seen from above. Strictly, this is a front elevation with a hat.

style.evidence: The wood ramp has about six steps (L 183, 176, 153, 125, 99, 76) plus dark red accents and gold drawer pulls. Outlines are tinted dark red-brown, with 0% neutral edge pixels, so there is no sticker look. Flat-fill coverage is 0%. The drawers have highlight edges, shadow corners and grain. The median of 12 colours per tile is below the references (17 and 20), and 18 distinct colours is well below their 38-40. The nine identical drawers are repetitive, but the piece sits acceptably beside the references and looks neither flat nor thin.
